name: Ibrahim of the Ottoman Empire

contribution: The sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1640 until his death in 1648.

checks.lead: Ibrahim (; Ottoman Turkish: ابراهيم; Turkish: İbrahim; 13 October 1617 – 18 August 1648) was the sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1640 until his death in 1648.
